title: Change a pipette tip hands-free
instruction: Eject the pipette's used orange tip into the bin, fit a fresh yellow tip from the rack, and return the pipette to its stand.
context: Medical and clinical laboratory technicians and biological technicians change contaminated tips without touching used or fresh tips by hand. The used tip belongs inside the HDPE biohazard bin; the pipette's own ejector removes it. A robot gripper has no thumb, so a fixed eject fork on the bin works the sleeve collar. A fresh tip is seated by pressing the nozzle straight into the rack. Dropped or knocked-over fresh tips count as contaminated. This is a one-handed laboratory operation; the left arm handles the pipette and the right arm parks away.
setup: Dimensions/coordinates are metres; masses kg. x forward, y left, z up; table top z=0.7475. All 8 named objects start upright at yaw zero; passive joints q=0. Pipette: origin (0.26,0.18,0.7635), blue RGB (0.12,0.36,0.75), free 0.100 kg base; polypropylene body, PVDF nozzle, stainless steel sleeve and balls. Shoulder underside is 0.130 above the nozzle origin; handle is 0.024 square by 0.036 high, centred 0.172 above that origin; left grip is 0.150 above it. The nozzle has a 0.004-radius spherical end bottoming on the tip's stop plate, and four 0.002-radius balls in a 0.0065 half-width square bore; each 0.001 kg ball slides inward 0.002 against a 275 N/m spring with 0.003 outward rest. The 0.008 kg sleeve slides down 0.014 against a 100 N/m spring with 0.001 outward rest; its square flange is 0.056 across, initial rim gap 0.006 (sleeve bottom 0.055 vs tip mouth top 0.049 above the origin). Radial capture 0.0035: tip mouth inner half-width 0.0115 minus the balls' 0.008 outer reach (0.006 radial plus 0.002 radius). Three free polypropylene tips, each 0.003 kg (about 0.001 real, increased for solver conditioning): tip_used starts seated at (0.26,0.18,0.7635), dark orange RGB (0.70,0.35,0.08) representing stained residue; tip_a at (0.2,0.105,0.7635) and tip_b at (0.13,0.185,0.7635), both yellow RGB (0.95,0.78,0.10), standing in their own rack holes. Each is 0.064 long: 0.015 lower stem tapering to 0.001 radius and 0.049 upper funnel, with a 0.028-square seating collar, 0.013-square neck, and mouth inner/outer widths 0.023/0.025. Stand: fixed acrylic, origin (0.26,0.18,0.7475), dark grey RGB (0.32,0.35,0.4); fork top z=0.8935, rails 0.010 wide by 0.056 long with a 0.034 gap supporting the pipette shoulder. Rack: fixed polypropylene, origin (0.2,0.105,0.7475), grey RGB (0.65,0.66,0.68); 0.003-thick plate top z=0.7675. Four 0.016-square holes at world xy (0.2,0.105), (0.13,0.185), (0.13,0.105), (0.2,0.185); the latter two start empty. Neck half-width 0.0065 in aperture half-width 0.008 gives 0.0015 side play; collar underside is 0.004 above tip origin and rests on the plate. Waste bin: fixed HDPE, origin (0.17,0.025,0.7475), purple RGB (0.32,0.25,0.35); interior 0.170 by 0.096, floor top z=0.7505, walls 0.027 above the floor with 0.003 thickness. Eject fork: fixed stainless steel on the bin, origin (0.17,0.025,0.7475), metallic grey RGB (0.35,0.4,0.45); 0.004-thick slotted plate spans z=0.8415 to 0.8455, with 0.042 slot width to catch the sleeve flange. All four fixtures are anchored, have no simulated mass, and use arena default friction. No object is attached or actuated; contact establishes about 0.0015 ball compression at spawn. Right arm parks with gripper open at (0.13,-0.19,0.8675). No other task props or marks. Every collider's centre and size is listed in README.md, section 'Collider table'.
scoring: Current end-state tiers are cumulative; losing a requirement removes its credit. Four violations force zero for the rest of the episode: (a) either gripper TCP comes less than 15 mm from any tip's world-aligned box; (b) the used tip is at least 3 mm off its seat, measured by origin distance in the nozzle frame, and the ejector sleeve has not been pushed at least 6 mm at any step since that tip was last seated; (c) any fresh tip is neither seated, in its own rack hole, nor engaged on the nozzle; (d) pipette tilt exceeds 45 degrees. Seated means absolute nozzle-frame axial origin error at most 1 mm, radial error at most 1.5 mm, and relative axis angle under 5 degrees. Engaged means absolute axial origin error at most 6 mm, radial error at most 3 mm, and relative axis angle under 15 degrees. An engaged fresh tip that later falls outside all three conditions triggers (c). In its own rack hole means origin xy within 6 mm of its hole, collar underside (local z=4 mm) between 2 mm below and 5 mm above rack plate top z=0.7675 m, and tilt under asin(5/14) degrees (about 20.9 degrees, the largest bearing tilt within that height band). A nudge within these limits does not trigger (c); lifting out and dropping onto the rack plate, table or bin does. Standing for the 0.75 tier means origin xy within 3 mm of its own hole, collar underside (local z=4 mm) within 2 mm of rack plate top z=0.7675 m, and tilt under 10 degrees. Score 0.25: used tip at least 20 mm off the nozzle by origin distance, at rest, its world-aligned box's footprint inside the bin interior x=0.085 to 0.255 m, y=-0.023 to 0.073 m (2 mm tolerance), and its lowest point from 2 mm below to 10 mm above the floor top z=0.7505 m. It may lie flat or lean on the eject fork's inner plate; any part over a wall or rim, half outside, or perched on the fork earns zero. Score 0.5: also either fresh tip seated. Score 0.75: also the pipette in its stand: shoulder point local (0,0,0.130) m within 2 mm vertically of fork top z=0.8935 m; shoulder y from 22 mm toward the slot mouth (-y) to 7 mm toward the back of y=0.180 m (the sleeve flange meets the back wall at 6 mm); for each rail, part of the yawed 44 x 12 mm shoulder bar's footprint at least 18 mm from x=0.260 m on that rail's side (1 mm onto the rail; inner edges 17 mm out) and from 28 mm toward the mouth to 40 mm toward the back of y=0.180 m (rail end to crossbar back), so a yawed bar whose only reach onto a rail is past the rail end fails; pipette tilt under 5 degrees; and the other fresh tip standing in its own hole. Score 1.0: also released, meaning each gripper TCP at least 30 mm from the pipette's and every tip's box, and all at rest, with every full-score condition held continuously for 1 s. At rest means pipette reported speed below 10 mm/s and spin below 0.5 rad/s; each tip changes origin by less than 0.5 mm and full orientation by less than 1.5 degrees between consecutive 20 Hz control steps. A halfway-pressed fresh tip 2.5 mm short of its seat earns disposal credit only (0.25). A seated fresh tip carried above the stand earns 0.5; parked while held or moving earns 0.75. A used tip still on the nozzle, swapped used/fresh identities, or the starting layout earns zero. Any outcome failing a tier earns the highest lower satisfied tier, otherwise zero. Success is score 1.0 held for a further 1 s. All sticky violations clear only on episode reset.
reset_notes: Restore the seated used tip, upright fresh tips in their own holes, and passive joints to zero; use object_jitter=0. No liquid is simulated. For real trials, build the pipette (with its sliding ejector sleeve and four spring balls), the three tips, the stand, the rack, the bin and the eject fork to the README's collider table, for example machined or 3D-printed; commercial tips do not fit the 16 mm square rack holes or the scored seat geometry. Colour marks contamination; no biological hazard is needed.
fidelity: The pipette and tips are oversized mock-ups: the tip mouth is 23 mm inside (real 200-1000 uL tips are about 5-8 mm), tips have a 28 mm square seating collar, a square nozzle bore with four preloaded spring balls replaces the conical friction fit, the sleeve has a 56 mm square flange, and a fixed eject fork on the bin stands in for the thumb-operated ejector button. Tips weigh 3 g (real about 1 g) for solver stability. No fluids, flex or wear; colour marks contamination.
